title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Show them how far they came
hook: Do your players know how much they have improved?
intro: Kids remember the losses, not the progress.
statement: Kids cannot always see their own growth.
q1: Do you point out specific improvements to each player —
q2: or let results speak for themselves?
q3: What could they not do in week one?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids keep working
t2: when they can see their progress.
cta: Coaches — how do you show improvement?
ctaLines: Week one versus now. A video. A quick note.
Point it out or let results show it?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do your players know how much they have improved?
It is midseason. Kids remember the losses, not the progress.
Kids cannot always see their own growth.
Point it out or let results show it. Both can work.
How do you show improvement? Share your habit in the comments.
